# PANDORA

A terminal client for building and testing jailbreak suites. Night Owl blue by default, purple when
jailbreak mode is on. Built on [`@opentui/core`](https://github.com/sst/opentui), runs on [Bun](https://bun.sh).

```
npm install -g pandora-tui
pandora
```

That's it. The `pandora` command opens the client.

## install

Requires **Bun ≥ 1.3** (OpenTUI's native core runs on Bun). Any truecolor terminal: Windows Terminal, iTerm2,
Kitty, WezTerm, GNOME Terminal etc.

```bash
# 1. get bun (skip if you have it)
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash              # macOS / Linux
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1 | iex"          # Windows

# 2. install pandora (npm, bun, pnpm or yarn all work)
npm install -g pandora-tui
# or run it once without installing:
bunx pandora-tui
```

```
pandora              open the client
pandora --home       where your data lives (default ~/.pandora, override with PANDORA_HOME)
pandora --config     path to config.json
pandora --version
pandora --help
```

Your config, sessions, jobs, exports and API keys live in `~/.pandora`, never inside the package, so
upgrades don't touch them and nothing personal is ever published.

## first run

1. `/login`: imports the key saved by the opencode CLI (`opencode auth login opencode`) for OpenCode Go / Console. Or…
2. `/key`: paste an API key for the current provider (ctrl+v / right-click / shift+insert)
3. `/models`: pick a provider and model. Live lists per provider, type to filter, ←/→ to switch provider
4. type a message. `/jailbreak` flips to purple mode where every message is a jb goal

Providers: **Anthropic (Claude)**, **Google Gemini**, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, OpenCode Go, OpenCode Console,
Ollama (local). Pandora speaks all four API families (OpenAI chat-completions, Anthropic Messages, OpenAI
Responses, Gemini) and picks the right one per model, including Claude/GPT/Gemini served through OpenCode.
Keys are stored **per provider** (`~/.pandora/state/keys.json`), so one provider's key is never sent to another.
For Claude: `/models` → Anthropic tab → `/key` → paste your `sk-ant-…` key.

## commands

| command | what it does |
|---|---|
| `/jailbreak` | toggle purple jailbreak mode |
| `/generate <goal>` | build a full jb suite (3 subagents: assault / clinical / layered, scored + fused) |
| `/forge <goal>` | assemble a jb locally, no API needed |
| `/patch <refusal>` | feed a refusal, get a surgical patch |
| `/models` `/key` `/login` | provider, model, credentials |
| `/copy` · `/copy all` | copy last reply · whole chat |
| `/sessions` `/new` `/jobs` `/usage` `/status` `/export` `/clear` `/help` `/exit` | housekeeping |
| `/target` `/tier` `/persona` `/techniques` `/effort` | generation settings |

## keys & mouse

| input | action |
|---|---|
| `enter` | send |
| `esc` | stop generation / close overlay or menu |
| `ctrl+o` `ctrl+s` `ctrl+t` `ctrl+g` | models · sessions · effort · subagents |
| `↑ ↓` `tab` | menu navigation / completion |
| `ctrl+c` | copy selection (or the prompt text) |
| `ctrl+v` / right-click / `shift+insert` | paste |
| drag | select text in the chat, auto-copies |
| click `⧉ copy` | copy that reply |
| hover / click | menu rows, overlay rows, provider tabs |
| wheel | scroll chat / lists |

## config

`~/.pandora/config.json` (created on first run):

```json
{
  "appName": "PANDORA",
  "jailbreakName": "LILITH",
  "api": { "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1", "key": "", "model": "deepseek-v4-flash" },
  "defaultTarget": "generic frontier model",
  "defaultTier": "standard",
  "signedResponses": true,
  "generatorPromptFile": ""
}
```

`generatorPromptFile` points at your own generator system prompt (a markdown file). Empty = the built-in
architect prompt. `appName` / `jailbreakName` rename the wordmark.

## develop

```bash
git clone <repo> && cd pandora && bun install
bun run src/index.ts             # run from source (data stays in the project folder)
bun run probe-interaction.ts     # headless regression probe
bun run cap.ts 200x50 jb         # headless capture
npm pack --dry-run               # see exactly what gets published
```

```
bin/pandora.js     launcher (plain node): data dir, first-run config, finds bun
src/index.ts       boot: renderer, key/paste/resize wiring
src/app.ts         the whole UI: splash, chat, overlays, transitions, mouse
src/art.ts         wordmark engine (font glyphs → gradient + effects)
src/theme.ts       Night Owl + purple palettes
src/models.ts      providers, live model lists, key store, opencode CLI key import
src/clip.ts        clipboard engine (OSC52 + native)
src/api.ts         OpenAI-compatible streaming client
src/gen.ts prompt.ts techniques.ts state.ts   generation, prompts, config/sessions
```

## updating

```
pandora update                         # = npm install -g pandora-tui@latest
```

Pandora checks npm for a newer version at startup and shows `⬆ x.y.z — run: pandora update` on the splash.
Disable the check with `PANDORA_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`. Your data in `~/.pandora` is never touched by updates.

## platforms

Linux, macOS and Windows (x64 + arm64). `.github/workflows/ci.yml` packs the tarball, installs it globally and
smoke-tests the real UI headlessly on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows and Alpine (musl); on Linux it also starts the
actual TUI on a pty. `scripts/smoke.ts` is the same check you can run locally.

## publish (maintainers)

```bash
npm login
npm pack --dry-run      # verify: no config.json, no state/, no keys
npm publish
```
